# Install the Vobiz MCP server

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-clients.mjs from package.json (version 1.2.1). Do not edit by hand: run npm run clients:gen. -->

Every client runs the same server. Pick one of two connection types:

- **Local (stdio):** runs `npx -y @vobiz/mcp@1.2.1` on your machine with your Auth ID and Auth Token.
- **Remote:** connects to the hosted connector `https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp` and signs you in with OAuth. No secrets go into a config file.

You need your **Auth ID** and **Auth Token** from the overview page of the [Vobiz console](https://console.vobiz.ai), plus Node.js 22.9 or newer for the local option.

| OpenAI Codex (CLI, IDE, app) | `codex mcp add vobiz --url https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp` | The Vobiz sign-in opens automatically |
| ChatGPT | **Plugins → + → Add custom MCP server** → `https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp` | Sign in, then use **@Vobiz** |

Every remote option signs in with OAuth on a Vobiz page, so no Auth Token is written to a config file. To run the server on your own machine instead, use the local options below.

With a local install, calling, messaging and account changes are off by default. To turn them on, add `VOBIZ_ENABLE_CALLS`, `VOBIZ_ENABLE_MESSAGING` or `VOBIZ_ENABLE_PROVISIONING` set to `"true"` in `env`. To trim the tool list, set `VOBIZ_TOOLSETS`, for example `calls,records,messaging,skills`.

## Claude (web, Desktop, mobile)

The hosted connector needs no install: you add a URL and sign in with your Vobiz credentials.

1. **Copy your credentials.** In the [Vobiz console](https://console.vobiz.ai) overview page, copy your **Auth ID** (`MA_…`, or `SA_…` for a sub-account) and **Auth Token**.
2. **Open Connectors.** In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, go to **Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector**. On Team and Enterprise plans an Owner adds it under **Admin settings → Connectors**, then each member connects their own account.
3. **Add the server.** Name it `Vobiz` and enter `https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp`. Leave the advanced OAuth fields empty and click **Add**.
4. **Connect and sign in.** Click **Connect**. On the Vobiz sign-in page, paste your Auth ID and Auth Token, optionally tick **Read-only access**, and click **Allow access**. You return to Claude, connected.
5. **Use it.** In a new chat, enable **Vobiz** in the tools menu and ask: _"What's my Vobiz balance, and how many calls are live right now?"_

To change between read-only and full access, disconnect and connect again. To revoke every app at once, rotate your Auth Token in the console.

## Claude Desktop extension

Download `vobiz-mcp-v1.2.1.mcpb` from the [latest release](https://github.com/vobiz-ai/Vobiz-MCP-Server/releases/latest) and open it. Claude Desktop asks for your Auth ID and Auth Token, and stores the token in the OS keychain. It also asks which capabilities to allow.

## Claude Code

**Plugin.** Installs the MCP server, the Vobiz docs MCP server and all Vobiz skills. Claude Code asks for your Auth ID and keeps the Auth Token in your OS credential store.

```text
/plugin install vobiz --marketplace vobiz-ai/Vobiz-MCP-Server
```

On older Claude Code versions, run `/plugin marketplace add vobiz-ai/Vobiz-MCP-Server` first, then `/plugin install vobiz@vobiz`.

**MCP server only:**

```bash
claude mcp add --transport stdio --env VOBIZ_AUTH_ID=MA_XXXXXXXX --env VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN=YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN --scope user vobiz -- npx -y @vobiz/mcp@1.2.1
# or remote, then run /mcp to sign in:
claude mcp add --transport http vobiz https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp
```

**Project `.mcp.json`.** Values come from your shell environment, so no secret goes into the file:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "${VOBIZ_AUTH_ID}",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "${VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## OpenAI Codex

Codex CLI, the IDE extension and the ChatGPT desktop app share `~/.codex/config.toml`.

```bash
codex mcp add vobiz --env VOBIZ_AUTH_ID=MA_XXXXXXXX --env VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN=YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN -- npx -y @vobiz/mcp@1.2.1
# or remote with OAuth:
codex mcp add vobiz --url https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp && codex mcp login vobiz
```

To keep the token out of the file, forward it from your shell instead:

```toml
[mcp_servers.vobiz]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"]
env_vars = ["VOBIZ_AUTH_ID", "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN"]
```

**Plugin.** Installs the Vobiz skills plus the hosted connector and docs servers:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add vobiz-ai/Vobiz-MCP-Server
# then /plugins in Codex and install "vobiz"
```

## ChatGPT

Open [chatgpt.com/plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins) and click **+**, then **Add custom MCP server**. Enter `https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp` with OAuth. Install it, then use it with `@Vobiz`.

## Gemini CLI

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/vobiz-ai/Vobiz-MCP-Server
```

Gemini asks for your Auth ID and Auth Token, and keeps the token in the system keychain. It also loads `GEMINI.md` with usage guidance. To change them later, run `gemini extensions config vobiz`. Without the extension:

```bash
gemini mcp add -s user -e VOBIZ_AUTH_ID=MA_XXXXXXXX -e VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN=YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN vobiz npx -y @vobiz/mcp@1.2.1
gemini mcp add -s user --transport http vobiz https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp
```

## Cursor

[Install in Cursor](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=vobiz&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkB2b2Jpei9tY3BAMS4yLjEiXSwiZW52Ijp7IlZPQklaX0FVVEhfSUQiOiIke2VudjpWT0JJWl9BVVRIX0lEfSIsIlZPQklaX0FVVEhfVE9LRU4iOiIke2VudjpWT0JJWl9BVVRIX1RPS0VOfSJ9fQ%3D%3D) (or open the deeplink `cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=vobiz&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkB2b2Jpei9tY3BAMS4yLjEiXSwiZW52Ijp7IlZPQklaX0FVVEhfSUQiOiIke2VudjpWT0JJWl9BVVRIX0lEfSIsIlZPQklaX0FVVEhfVE9LRU4iOiIke2VudjpWT0JJWl9BVVRIX1RPS0VOfSJ9fQ==`). The link reads `VOBIZ_AUTH_ID` and `VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN` from your environment. You can also add the server to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` (global) or `.cursor/mcp.json` (project):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "${env:VOBIZ_AUTH_ID}",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "${env:VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Remote: `{ "mcpServers": { "vobiz": { "url": "https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp" } } }`.

## VS Code / GitHub Copilot

- **Install links:** [Install in VS Code](https://insiders.vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=vobiz&config=%7B%22command%22%3A%22npx%22%2C%22args%22%3A%5B%22-y%22%2C%22%40vobiz%2Fmcp%401.2.1%22%5D%2C%22env%22%3A%7B%22VOBIZ_AUTH_ID%22%3A%22%24%7Benv%3AVOBIZ_AUTH_ID%7D%22%2C%22VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN%22%3A%22%24%7Benv%3AVOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN%7D%22%7D%7D) (local, reads your environment) or [Install remote connector](vscode:mcp/install?%7B%22name%22%3A%22vobiz%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.vobiz.ai%2Fmcp%22%7D).
- **CLI:** `code --add-mcp '{"name":"vobiz","command":"npx","args":["-y","@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"]}'`

To have VS Code prompt for the token and store it securely, add `.vscode/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "type": "promptString",
      "id": "vobiz-auth-id",
      "description": "Vobiz Auth ID"
    },
    {
      "type": "promptString",
      "id": "vobiz-auth-token",
      "description": "Vobiz Auth Token",
      "password": true
    }
  ],
  "servers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "${input:vobiz-auth-id}",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "${input:vobiz-auth-token}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Windsurf / Devin Desktop

Edit `~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json`, or `%APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json` on Windows:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "${env:VOBIZ_AUTH_ID}",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "${env:VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN}"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- **Remote:** `{ "mcpServers": { "vobiz": { "serverUrl": "https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp" } } }`
- **Devin CLI:** `devin mcp add -s user vobiz https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp && devin mcp login vobiz`

## Zed

Add this to `~/.config/zed/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "MA_XXXXXXXX",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

For the remote connector, use `"vobiz": { "url": "https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp" }`. Zed runs the OAuth sign-in.

## Cline

```bash
cline mcp add vobiz https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp --transport http --yes
```

For a local server, add the `vobiz` entry below under **MCP Servers → Configure**:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "MA_XXXXXXXX",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN"
      },
      "disabled": false,
      "autoApprove": []
    }
  }
}
```

## Goose

Hosted (OAuth): open `goose://extension?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.vobiz.ai%2Fmcp&type=streamable_http&id=vobiz&name=Vobiz&description=Vobiz%20calls%2C%20numbers%2C%20SIP%20and%20messaging&timeout=300`.

Local: [Install in Goose](goose://extension?cmd=npx&arg=-y&arg=%40vobiz%2Fmcp%401.2.1&id=vobiz&name=Vobiz&description=Vobiz%20calls%2C%20numbers%2C%20SIP%20and%20messaging&env=VOBIZ_AUTH_ID%3DVobiz%20Auth%20ID&env=VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN%3DVobiz%20Auth%20Token&timeout=300). Goose prompts for the Auth ID and Auth Token and stores them in the system keyring. You can also run `goose configure` → **Add Extension** → **Command-line Extension** with `npx -y @vobiz/mcp@1.2.1`.

## JetBrains AI Assistant

Open **Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, click **Add**, then paste:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vobiz": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"
      ],
      "env": {
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_ID": "MA_XXXXXXXX",
        "VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN": "YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Continue

Create `.continue/mcpServers/vobiz.yaml`:

```yaml
name: Vobiz
version: 1.2.1
schema: v1
mcpServers:
  - name: Vobiz
    type: stdio
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@vobiz/mcp@1.2.1"]
    env:
      VOBIZ_AUTH_ID: ${{ secrets.VOBIZ_AUTH_ID }}
      VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN }}
```

## LM Studio

[Install in LM Studio](lmstudio://add_mcp?name=vobiz&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoibnB4IiwiYXJncyI6WyIteSIsIkB2b2Jpei9tY3BAMS4yLjEiXSwiZW52Ijp7IlZPQklaX0FVVEhfSUQiOiJNQV9YWFhYWFhYWCIsIlZPQklaX0FVVEhfVE9LRU4iOiJZT1VSX0FVVEhfVE9LRU4ifX0%3D), then replace the placeholder Auth ID and Auth Token in `mcp.json`. To do it by hand, go to **Program → Install → Edit mcp.json** and add the `vobiz` server from the JetBrains example.

## Warp

Open **Settings → Agents → MCP servers → + Add**, then paste the JetBrains example. Or put it in `~/.warp/.mcp.json`. For the remote connector, use `{ "mcpServers": { "vobiz": { "url": "https://mcp.vobiz.ai/mcp" } } }`.
